issues: Treats the two abstract-level model sources as full-text evidence: labels them 'full_text（本次另保存开放获取全文）' and uses full-text-only fields, contrary to the brief's source access levels and mustNotDo.
Asserts that full texts were saved and verified (PMC12832424, PMC12557738) although no full text is present in the supplied sources, leaving those full-text-derived claims unbonded and unverified.
judge.rationale: Delivers a thorough scoping appraisal, keeps patient-cohort overlap correctly unresolved, and explains the required identifiers, dates, and eligibility definitions. Safety framing is appropriate. However it upgrades the two abstract-level model sources to full text and relies on full-text-only details, violating the brief's access-level/mustNotDo instructions and weakening evidence bonding.
